field_principles.action_entropy: Shannon entropy over executed live action/coordinate choices as a bare float.
field_principles.arc_live_levelup_ready: bare bool proving Exp5520 and the registry reread allowed the live attempt.
field_principles.banking_gate: bare bool equal to offline_reproduced=true and reproduced_levels>=1 for solve_provenance=live_agent_self_discovery.
field_principles.honest_verdict: one-line verdict starting complete:, honest_null:, or blocked:.
field_principles.live_attempts: bare int count of runtime actions executed by the live agent.
field_principles.offline_reproduced: true only when the live-discovered trajectory passes the standard offline replay gate.
field_principles.registry_delta: bare int registry total delta; nonzero only when the banking gate is true.
field_principles.repeated_coordinate_rate: fraction of executed live coordinate choices that repeated a prior coordinate, as a bare float.
field_principles.reproduced_levels: integer new levels banked from the live-discovered trajectory; success requires >=1.
field_principles.reproduction_command: exact replay command when a live trajectory was reproduced, else null.
field_principles.salience_coverage_rate: fraction of executed live coordinate choices covering proposed salience coordinates, as a bare float.
field_principles.selected_game: Exp5520-selected registry-safe game id; empty only when the readiness gate blocks before live runtime.
field_principles.selected_level: Exp5520-selected unreproduced level label or int; success must be strictly deeper than the registry depth.
field_principles.trajectory_log_path: path to the detailed trajectory log containing observations, proposed actions, verifier feedback, and diversity metrics.
